Pure utility/type module: no DOM, browser HTML, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI imports — zero imports at all. Relies only on the standard Promise microtask queue, which behaves identically under React Native (Hermes/JSC), so it runs unchanged.

Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
